name: Nuxan
description: The Nuxan were a sentient humanoid species from the Nux system in the Mid Rim Territories. They were distinguished by their unpleasant, rotten odor. The species possessed green skin riddled with brown spots, a pair of green eyes which had brown markings directly above and below, a pair of five-fingered hands, and fin on the back of their heads. Bodo Linx was a Nuxan informant during the Imperial Era who could speak Galactic Basic Standard.
